id: 610-西突厥射匱擊處羅可汗之戰
theater: 碎葉伊列河谷與金山北麓

battle.name: 西突厥射匱擊處羅可汗之戰
battle.theater: 碎葉伊列河谷與金山北麓
battle.brief: 大業六年（610）冬，處羅之子射匱在西突厥內部奪位自立，殺死同族可汗與權臣，漢文史料稱其為「射匱擊處羅可汗」。碎葉伊列河一帶的聯盟自此裂成互攻兩派；隋煬帝無力用兵介入，只能以冊封和親承認既成事實。卡面羅馬標槍雖不在現場，其投射兵器邏輯正是兩造步卒破騎兵的老辦法。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方，表面是西突厥聯盟與隋朝，真正決定局面的卻是聯盟內部的兩股勢力。隋朝一方由中央直轄的邊軍體系承擔：兵制以府兵為骨幹，另有宿衛禁軍、州鎮戍兵與臨時徵發的雜役丁夫，調度歸尚書省與行軍總管；北線的靈州、朔州、涼州與西域的張掖、敦煌是兵源、糧秣與馬匹的轉運樞紐，裴矩一系的官員在張掖主持對西域與草原的招撫、互市與冊封，隋煬帝本人則把北方的注意力一半放在即將到來的攻高句麗之戰上。西突厥一方是阿史那氏為核心的可汗家族與諸部聯盟，沒有城郭，牙帳即中樞，兵以游騎射為主，編制上分可汗直屬的近衛騎、各部部眾，以及葉護、俟斤、啜一類的部帥；射匱一方是處羅可汗的舊部與新附諸部，達頭可汗一方則據有西部牧地與通往西域的商道。捲入者還有吐火羅、康居與西域諸城邦：它們不派大軍參戰，卻用商隊、馬匹與情報決定了草原聯盟可以把仗打多久。三方形成的格局是：隋朝要的是一個安分的對手與一條通商道，西突厥內部要的是可汗位，於是外交、冊封與內戰同時進行。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were, on the surface, the Western Turkic confederation and the Sui dynasty, but what actually decided the outcome were two rival factions inside the confederation. On the Sui side stood the frontier armies under direct central command: the military register system of fubing formed the backbone, supplemented by the palace guard, the garrison troops of the prefectures and counties, and levies of labourers and transport; the northern centres of Lingzhou, Shuozhou and Liangzhou, together with Zhangye and Dunhuang in the Western Regions, were where troops, grain and horses were raised and shifted, and officials of Pei Ju's school presided at Zhangye over the pacification, the caravans and the investitures that linked the Sui court to the steppe. The Sui emperor himself could give the north only part of his attention, since he was busy with the coming campaign against Goguryeo. The Western Turks were a confederation built around the Ashina ruling house and its tribal blocs, without cities or walls; the khagan's tent was its hub, fighting was the business of roving horse-archers, and the order of battle ran from the khan's own guard through the tribal contingents to the leaders who bore such titles as yabghu, segin and chur. On one side stood Shegui together with the old retainers of Chuluo Khan and the tribes that had attached themselves to him; on the other stood Tatou Khan, who held the western pastures and the caravan roads into the Western Regions. Involved in a wider sense were Tocharia, Kangju and the oasis states: they sent no great armies to the field, but their caravans, horses and intelligence decided how long a war on the steppe could be fought. The triangular situation that resulted was this: the Sui wanted a docile neighbour and an open trade road, the Western Turks wanted the khaganate, and so diplomacy, investiture and civil war all ran at the same time.
people: 關鍵人物分在兩邊。隋朝這邊，隋煬帝楊廣是全部決策的中心：大業六年前後他正在涿郡一帶巡塞、修長城、籌備東征高句麗，對草原的處置只能靠詔書、冊封與和親來完成；實際經手的是裴矩這類通曉西域與草原情勢的官員，張掖的互市與使者網是他經營多年留下的管道；宗室女安義公主是這套政策最昂貴的一件工具。突厥這邊，射匱是這場衝突的主事者——他以處羅可汗之子的身分起兵奪位，得到舊部擁戴，也因此背上了「擊處羅」的兇名；他的對手或合作者是泥利龐特一系與其子、達頭可汗，以及被史書記為殺死射匱的部將藥師那達。往後的因果也牽涉到別人：射匱死後，達頭可汗在隋朝出兵策應下於大業十三年（617）兵敗身死，其子毗伽可汗在武德初年（619）重新集結部眾反唐，最終在唐貞觀四年（630）被李靖夜襲陰山所破。人物線索到此為止：西突厥的分裂不是被隋朝打平的，而是被自己人打散的。
peopleEn: The key figures fall on two sides. For the Sui, the decision-maker was the emperor Yang Guang himself: in the years around 610 he was touring the northern frontier at Zhuojun, repairing the Great Wall and preparing the eastern campaign against Goguryeo, so that the steppe could be handled only by edict, investiture and marriage; the hands that actually did the work were officials such as Pei Ju, who understood the Western Regions and the steppe and who had built up a network of envoys and markets at Zhangye over many years; the imperial clanswoman Anyi Princess was the most expensive single instrument of that policy. On the Turkic side the protagonist was Shegui, who rose with the support of the old retainers of Chuluo Khan and took the khaganate by force, earning the ill-famed name that records the slaying of Chuluo; his rivals were the line of Nili Panta and his son, Tatou Khan, and the officer whom the histories credit with killing Shegui, Yashinoda. Later consequences drew in other men: after Shegui's death Tatou Khan was defeated and killed in 617 with Sui military support, and his son, the khan known as Pijian, mustered his people again and rebelled against the Tang in 619, only to be broken in 630 by Li Jing's night attack at Yinshan. The thread of personalities ends there: the Western Turkic confederation was not beaten down by the Sui; it was broken apart by its own people.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍（Pilum）並不在天山北麓的營帳裡，它是同一類投射兵器的歐洲原型，而它要對照的正是西突厥與隋軍手裡的標槍、梭矛。羅馬標槍的槍桿中空，外面包覆硬木，前端裝鐵矛頭；它最要命的地方不在重量而在結構——捅進盾面之後槍桿就斷在盾上，盾牌連槍帶人退不回本陣，只能連同插在上面的半截槍一起丟在原地。功能相同的一件東西在西域與中原叫做標槍或梭矛：西突厥的步卒把細長木桿的前端綁上骨矛或鐵矛，成排投擲，用來迎擊衝鋒的騎兵；隋軍的步卒同樣用標槍掩護弩手射擊，並在騎兵逼近到數十步內時以密集的投槍打散其陣形。除投射兵器外，這一戰線上真正在起作用的是三樣東西：複合角弓，突厥弓手的有效射程與隋軍的弩相當甚至更遠，弓手的密度是草原軍隊的第一位戰力；札甲與皮甲，突厥重騎的鎧甲式樣與漢晉以來的明光鎧同源，隋軍邊軍則以甲騎為骨幹；還有馬具，鞍與鐙讓西突厥得以維持以弓刀為核心的全天候騎兵，離開水草就寸步難行。營具方面，遊牧軍隊把帳幕、車帳與備用馬匹組成可以移動的堡壘，這就是他們的補給線全部。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on this card was not in any camp north of the Tianshan; it is the European archetype of the same class of missile weapon, and the things it should be compared against are the javelins and the spear-javelins carried by the Western Turks and by the Sui army. The shaft of a Roman pilum was hollow, sheathed in hard wood and fitted with an iron head; what made it lethal was not its weight but its structure, for once it had punched into a shield the shaft snapped off and stayed in the shield, so that the shield, with half a javelin still standing in it, could not be carried back into the ranks and had to be abandoned on the ground. A functionally identical object in the Western Regions and in China was called a biaoqiang or a suomao: the infantry of the Western Turks bound bone or iron points onto slender wooden shafts and threw them in files to meet charging horsemen, while Sui infantry used the same weapon to screen their crossbowmen and to break up cavalry that had closed to within a few tens of paces. Besides missile weapons, three things really mattered on this front: the composite reflex bow, whose effective range for Turkic archers equalled or exceeded that of the Sui crossbows, the density of the archers being the first strength of a grass-roots army; lamellar and leather armour, the Western Turkic heavy cavalry wearing harness of the same family as the Mingguang armour of Han and Jin China, while the Sui frontier troops had armoured riders as their backbone; and horse tack, for saddle and stirrup were what allowed the Western Turks to keep up a mounted force whose whole method was the bow and the sabre, a force that could not move a step away from water and grass. On the logistics side, the nomads assembled tents, wagon-tents and remounts into a fortress that could move with them, and that was the whole of their line of supply.
tactics: 草原上的打法與中原不同。西突厥的軍隊不設長久營壘，不挖壕，不排方陣：他們以牙帳為軸，諸部散牧，一旦有事就靠馬上互通消息，集合為數千至數萬的騎隊，在選定的地點與時間上突然出現，打完就走。射匱奪位時用的正是這一套：以近衛騎夜襲可汗的牙帳，用強弓在幾百步內把守帳的部眾射散，再以標槍與長矛壓住重新結陣的敵騎，逐帳逐部地分化各部首領；他的關鍵不是打贏一場會戰，而是讓各部在幾天之內分別倒戈。隋朝應對這種草原騎兵靠的是另一套技術：以靈州、朔州一線的邊軍與長城線上的烽燧守住通道，關鍵時刻才以步兵下馬執長槊結密集縱隊，用弩的齊射壓住衝鋒的起步，用標槍的齊射打散已到面前的騎群，再以兩翼騎兵繞擊側後；七年後唐軍在諾真水破薛延陀，用的正是這一套。外交與戰術在這十年裡是同一件事：冊封、和親、互市是探測對方內部裂縫的手段，離間一旦奏效，草原上的會戰往往根本不必打；安義公主的婚約本身也是一次情報與合法性的交換，隋朝在婚禮上確認了新可汗的地位，同時摸清了西突厥的部眾人數與派系歸屬。補給線是雙方的弱點：遊牧軍隊靠馬背上的帳幕與隨軍牲畜維持，追擊一段之後就必須回營；隋軍則靠屯田、積粟與車隊，長城線上的物資轉運速度決定了他們能追多遠。
tacticsEn: Grass-roots warfare was not fought the way the Central Plain fought it. The Western Turkic army raised no permanent camp, dug no trench and formed no square: it pivoted on the khagan's tent, the tribes grazed apart, and when something had to be done the news travelled by horse and the horsemen mustered by the thousand or by the tens of thousands, appearing suddenly at a chosen place and hour and leaving as soon as the business was done. That is exactly the method Shegui used when he seized the khaganate: his guard cavalry struck the khan's tent by night, strong bows dispersed the households that defended it from a few hundred paces, and javelins and long spears held down the enemy while he reformed; then he went tent by tent, tribe by tribe, splitting the leaders apart. His key was not winning a pitched battle but making each of the tribes change sides within a few days. The Sui answered cavalry of that kind with a different technology: frontier troops at Lingzhou and Shuozhou together with the beacon towers along the Great Wall held the corridors shut, and only at the decisive moment did infantry dismount, take their long spears and form dense columns, use massed crossbow shots to smother the start of a charge, use massed javelin volleys to break up the cavalry that had already arrived, and then send the wings round the flanks. The Tang army at Nozhen River seven years later used precisely this method. Diplomacy and tactics were the same business in those ten years: investiture, marriage and caravan trade were instruments for probing the fissures inside the enemy camp, and once the scheme of driving wedges between the factions worked, the pitched battle on the steppe often never had to be fought at all. The marriage contract with Anyi Princess was itself an exchange of intelligence and legitimacy: the Sui confirmed the new khan's position at the wedding while taking the measure of the tribes and their loyalties. Supply was the weak point of both sides. A nomad army lived off the tents on its horses and its own herds and had to fall back to camp after a certain stretch of pursuit; the Sui lived off the fields, the stored grain and the wagon trains, and the speed at which stores could be moved along the Great Wall decided how far its pursuit could go.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處，這場衝突本身的數目則幾乎空白。其一，時間：射匱起兵奪位在大業六年（610），同年冬遣使入朝請婚，隋煬帝以安義公主和親；公主於大業七年（611）抵達西突厥牙帳，而射匱也在那一年被自己人殺死，這樁婚事維持不到一年。其二，隋朝一邊可與前例對照的數字，是開皇十八年冬北伐的「發兵三十萬」與開皇十九年達頭死後「眾十餘萬」降隋，但那是十一年前另一場戰爭的數字；同樣，開皇二十年朔州清水一役「斬首及俘獲數萬」、追奔至磧口數百里，屬開皇舊事，不可挪用到本次。西突厥方面的人數沒有留下可靠記載，各書只以「眾」字概括。其三，距離與行程：碎葉在伊列河下游北岸，隋朝使節與和親隊伍自敦煌、張掖西行，關中到碎葉的行程以月計，全程靠馬匹、駱駝與牛車換站接力，路上要穿過焉耆與龜茲的稅卡，這也是西域城邦能左右草原聯盟的原因。其四，隋朝邊軍的規模：《隋書》記靈州、朔州一線的屯兵與戍卒以萬計；裴矩在張掖招致西域商旅，記有商胡數千家、諸國二十餘，馬匹交易以千匹計。其五，卡面那支羅馬標槍的規格：半米左右的中空槍桿加鐵矛頭，捅穿盾面即折斷——這些數字說明的是消耗比，一支標槍換一面不能再用的盾，草原上沒有可以長期堆積的消耗品儲備。其六，後果的可核對點：射匱死於611年，達頭可汗敗亡於617年，毗伽可汗619年起兵，630年李靖夜襲陰山破東突厥，斬首萬餘級、俘男女十餘萬。傷亡與斬獲的細數各家記載互相矛盾，本節不列。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in a few places, while the numbers for this clash itself are almost entirely blank. First, the chronology: Shegui rose and seized the khaganate in 610, the sixth year of the Daye era; in the winter of the same year he sent envoys to the Sui court to ask for a marriage, and the emperor Yang Guang gave him the Anyi Princess; the princess reached the Western Turkic tent in 611, the seventh year of Daye, and in that same year Shegui was killed by his own people, so the marriage lasted less than a year. Second, the Sui figures that can be compared with a precedent: the levy of three hundred thousand men in the winter of the eighteenth year of Kaihuang and the more than one hundred thousand who came over to the Sui after the death of Datou in the nineteenth year of Kaihuang - but those are the numbers of a different war eleven years earlier; likewise the several tens of thousands cut down and captured at Qingshui in Shuozhou in the twentieth year of Kaihuang, and the pursuit of several hundred li to Qikou, belong to the old Kaihuang campaigns and cannot be carried over to this one. No reliable record of the size of the Western Turkic host survives; the histories merely say a multitude. Third, distance and travel: Suyab stands on the north bank of the lower Ili, and Sui envoys and the marriage convoy went west from Dunhuang and Zhangye; the journey from the heart of Guanzhong to Suyab was measured in months and was relayed by horses, camels and ox carts, passing through the toll stations of Yanqi and Kucha, which is exactly why the oasis states could hold the balance of power on the steppe. Fourth, the scale of the Sui frontier forces: the Book of Sui records the garrison troops and the colonised farming posts of the Lingzhou and Shuozhou line in the tens of thousands; and it records that Pei Ju drew several thousand merchant families of the Western Regions and more than twenty states to Zhangye, with horse trade counted in thousands of head. Fifth, the specification of the Roman pilum on the card: a hollow shaft about half a metre long with an iron head, which snaps off once it has punched through a shield - these figures state a ratio of consumption, a javelin bought in exchange for a shield that can never be used again, and on the steppe there was no store of such consumables to be accumulated. Sixth, the checkable points of the sequel: Shegui died in 611, Tatou Khan was defeated and killed in 617, the khan known as Pijian rebelled in 619, and in 630 Li Jing struck the Eastern Turks by night at Yinshan, cutting down more than ten thousand and taking over one hundred thousand captives. The detailed figures for dead and taken vary from book to book and are not listed here.
cause: 打起來的起因有三層。最表層是可汗位的繼承：處羅可汗（隋朝所封的啟民可汗）死後，泥利龐特、佉體一系相繼在位，到大業年間處羅之子射匱以兵自立，殺死同族的可汗與權臣，把大可汗的位置搶到手；草原聯盟靠血緣與婚約維繫，一旦出現這種弒逆，各部就可以各自選邊，聯盟隨即變成內戰。中間層是隋朝的因素：開皇後期兩次北伐把達頭部打散，隋朝在漠南安置降眾、冊封代理人，等於在草原內部插了一枚釘子；大業年間，隋煬帝把主力用於東征高句麗與巡塞修城，北線的邊軍只能守不能攻，對西突厥的內部變動既不能不管，也沒有能力直接介入，只能用冊封、互市與和親承認既成事實，同時把西突厥推向與高句麗相反的方向。第三層是草原自身的經濟與生存壓力：七世紀初的伊列河與天山一帶水草的承載力有限，部眾的生計靠逐水草與向西域城邦賣馬購物，一旦一位新可汗要求重新分配牧地和部眾，衝突就會從牙帳蔓延到整片牧地。於是610年的局勢是：隋朝願意花一宗室的女子和一批馬匹換取安寧，西突厥內部則要靠刀劍決定誰說了算，而真正開戰的，是同一批部眾的忠誠。
causeEn: The outbreak had three layers of cause. The outermost was the succession to the khaganate: after the death of Chuluo Khan, the man the Sui had invested as Qimin Khan, the line of Nili Panta and Kati succeeded one another to the throne, and by the Daye years Shegui, the son of Chuluo, rose with troops in hand, killed the khan of his own blood and the minister who stood beside him, and seized the great khaganate for himself. A grass-roots league is held together by kinship and marriage; once a filicide of this kind appears, every tribe is free to choose a side, and the league turns at once into a civil war. The middle layer was the Sui: the two northern campaigns of the later Kaihuang years broke the Datou faction, and the Sui settled its surrendered people in the desert's south and invested proxies there, which was in effect a nail driven into the steppe. In the Daye years the Sui emperor committed his main strength to the campaign against Goguryeo and to touring the northern frontier and repairing the walls, so that the northern armies could hold but not strike; internal upheaval in the Western Turks could be neither ignored nor confronted directly, and could only be acknowledged through investiture, trade and marriage, while the Western Turks were pushed in the direction opposite to Goguryeo. The third layer was the economic and ecological pressure of the steppe itself: in the early seventh century the grazing capacity of the Ili and Tianshan region was finite, and the livelihood of the people rested on moving with the water and on selling horses and buying goods in the oasis towns. The moment a new khan demanded a redistribution of pastures and followers, the quarrel spread from the tent out over the whole range. So the situation in 610 was this: the Sui was willing to pay for peace with an imperial clanswoman and a batch of horses, the Western Turks meant to settle the question of the khaganate with the sword, and the thing that actually set the tribes fighting was the loyalty of the same people to one khan or another.
impact: 610年的結果在草原上造成連鎖反應。射匱奪位成功，但他的成功本身就是分裂的源頭：西突厥聯盟在這一年之後不再是同一支軍隊，而是互相攻殺的兩派加上一群觀望的小部。611年射匱被自己的部將殺死後，聯盟徹底崩解，泥利龐特一系與達頭可汗爭奪牧地，隋朝則在靈州、朔州一線加緊防禦，同時用出兵策應的方式挑動對方內鬥；617年達頭可汗兵敗身死，其子毗伽可汗在619年重新集結部眾反唐，把戰火燒到唐初的邊境，最終在630年被李靖夜襲陰山所破，草原上的汗號自此改換旗幟。對隋朝本身，這幾年買到的只是時間：安義公主的和親沒有換來西突厥的安分，射匱的死亡沒有解決草原問題，反而讓一個更能打的達頭系上台；隋朝把國力投向高句麗，把北疆留給了唐。對武器史而言，這一戰線的意義在於它顯示了「一次性投射兵器」在歐亞大陸兩端的平行發展：地中海的羅馬標槍與天山北麓的標槍、梭矛採用同一套邏輯——密集的齊射用來拆解騎兵的衝鋒節奏，代價是槍與盾的一次性報廢。當然要說清楚：卡面這支羅馬標槍不在此役現場，比較的是原理，不是同型兵器流傳的證據。
impactEn: The outcome of 610 set off a chain reaction on the steppe. Shegui's seizure of power succeeded, but that success was itself the source of the split: after that year the Western Turkic league was no longer a single army but two factions tearing at each other, plus a number of smaller tribes watching and waiting. When Shegui was killed by his own officer in 611 the league collapsed completely, the line of Nili Panta and Tatou Khan fought over the pastures, and the Sui tightened its defence on the Lingzhou and Shuozhou line while quietly encouraging the quarrel with men and money. Tatou Khan was defeated and killed in 617; his son, the khan known as Pijian, mustered his people once more and rebelled against the Tang in 619, carrying the war to the borders of the early Tang, until he was broken in 630 by Li Jing's night attack at Yinshan and the khagan's title on the steppe changed hands. For the Sui itself, those years bought nothing but time: the marriage of Anyi Princess did not buy the peace of the Western Turks, and the death of Shegui did not solve the steppe question, it merely handed the field to the more formidable line of Tatou. The Sui spent its strength on Goguryeo and left the northern frontier to the Tang. For the history of weapons, the significance of this front is that it shows the parallel development of the one-shot missile weapon at the two ends of Eurasia: the Roman pilum of the Mediterranean and the biaoqiang and suomao of the Tianshan north use the same logic - massed volleys to break the rhythm of a cavalry charge, at the price of writing off the javelin and the shield each time. It should be said plainly: the Roman pilum on this card was not present in this campaign, and what is being compared is a principle, not evidence of the same weapon travelling from one place to another.
result: 結算這一場衝突：610年，射匱在西突厥內部奪位成功，殺死同族的可汗與權臣，自立為大可汗，聯盟自此分裂；以「射匱擊處羅」為號的名號，就是這次弒逆留下的記號。同年冬射匱遣使請婚，隋煬帝許以安義公主，次年公主抵達牙帳，和親成婚；611年射匱被部將所殺，《新唐書·列女傳》記公主在突厥十餘年，同行者多遭殺害，直至可汗死後才得歸唐，貞觀年間太宗遣使迎她回長安。隋朝在這場戰爭裡沒有打過一場會戰，它取得的是承認與拖延：西突厥分裂、無力南下的那兩三年，正好讓隋煬帝把主力轉向高句麗。代價是草原的秩序被徹底打爛，達頭一系乘勢坐大，最終把西突厥整合起來的實力送進了唐軍的射程。往後的收尾不在610年，而在617年與630年：617年隋朝出兵策應，達頭可汗兵敗身死；619年毗伽可汗起兵反唐；630年唐軍夜襲陰山破之，斬首萬餘級、俘男女十餘萬，頉利可汗被擒，義成公主遇害。射匱這場奪位之戰，是隋唐之間北方戰線的真正起點：它沒有一場正面會戰的勝負，卻用一次弒逆、一場和親與一批俘虜，把草原的分裂一直帶到唐太宗手上。
resultEn: Settling the account of this clash: in 610 Shegui succeeded in seizing power inside the Western Turks, killed the khan of his own blood and the ministers around him, stood up as great khan in his own right, and the league split from that moment on; the name that records it, Shegui who struck down Chuluo, is the scar left by that filicide. In the winter of the same year Shegui sent envoys to ask for a marriage, the Sui emperor Yang Guang granted him the Anyi Princess, and the next year the princess reached the tent and the marriage was made. In 611 Shegui was killed by one of his own officers; the New Book of Tang, in its account of exemplary women, records that the princess spent more than ten years among the Turks, that most of those who had gone out with her were killed, and that only after the khan's death could she return, the emperor Taizong of Tang sending envoys to bring her home to Chang'an in the Zhenguan era. The Sui fought no pitched battle in this war; what it won was recognition and delay, for the two or three years in which the Western Turks were split and unable to march south were exactly the years the Sui emperor needed to turn his main strength towards Goguryeo. The price was that the order of the steppe was smashed, that the line of Tatou rose on the ruins, and that a reunited Western Turkic strength was finally delivered into Tang bowshot. The ending came not in 610 but in 617 and 630: in 617 the Sui intervened with troops and Tatou Khan was defeated and killed; in 619 the khan known as Pijian rebelled against the Tang; in 630 the Tang army struck at Yinshan by night, cutting down more than ten thousand, taking over one hundred thousand captives, seizing the khan of the Eastern Turks, and the Princess Yicheng was killed. This war of succession was the true beginning of the northern front between Sui and Tang: it decided no pitched battle, yet with one filicide, one marriage and a body of captives it carried the fracture of the steppe all the way to the hands of Emperor Taizong.
